name: gravity-stage0-development-verification
description: Stage 0 and Milestone 0 verification graph with bounded Stage1/Stage2 handoffs and fixed, non-authoritative Stage3--10 compiler candidate graphs for evidence-producing development loops.

scope.stage1_handoff: SH-01 planner and parallel-runner unit preflight
scope.stage3_handoff: fixed SH08/C7 development batches through a fresh proof candidate; no reviewed attestation or authority promotion
scope.stage4_handoff: fixed C8/SH09 source, adapter, authenticated, public, and manual proof-candidate nodes; no generic passthrough or authority promotion
scope.stage5_handoff: fixed C9 ownership source, kernel, adapter, public, and manual proof-candidate nodes; no Stage3/Stage4 replay or authority promotion
scope.stage6_handoff: fixed C10 safety source, kernel, C9 adapter, public, and manual proof-candidate nodes; no legacy broad replay or authority promotion
scope.stage7_handoff: fixed C11 MIR source, C10 adapter, public, and manual proof-candidate nodes; no legacy broad replay or authority promotion
scope.stage8_handoff: fixed C12 shape, C11-domain evidence, and public development nodes; no proof candidate or authority promotion
scope.stage9_handoff: fixed C13 source-shape gate followed by an evidence-only boundary over a reconstructed C12 carrier; no optimization credit, proof candidate, target lowering, or authority promotion
scope.stage10_handoff: fixed W1 C14 static admission, ordinary direct-mutation discriminator, independent SH25 source catalog, narrow SH25/SH26 fixture consumer, and manual hostile stable-candidate nodes; no automatic packet matrix, proof candidate, or authority promotion
included: the Stage1 SH-01 planner and parallel-runner unit preflight
the fixed Stage3 runner unit and SH08/C7 development graph
the fixed Stage4 C8/SH09 development graph
the fixed Stage5 C9 ownership development graph
the fixed Stage6 C10 safety development graph
the fixed Stage7 C11 MIR development graph
the fixed Stage8 C12/SH13 development graph
the fixed Stage9 SH16/C13 evidence-only development boundary
the fixed Stage10 W1/C14 proportional development graph
first hosted hello and core application fixtures
the focused project-structure extraction compatibility gate
the existing Clojure bootstrap test surface
excluded: native, kernel, GPU, distributed, and AI production targets
